reason: My Excel and Telegram chats work, I have never paid for a CRM and I do not want to pay 25 dollars a month for something my team will ignore after a week. The free move of data is nice, but I still have to retrain everyone.
objection: Moving my data from amoCRM or Excel will take weeks and my staff will keep using Telegram anyway, and you have no customers I can ask about it.
would_change_my_mind: A person from a company like mine in Uzbekistan showing me it running on their real Telegram chats, and your team moving my data in front of me in a day or two.
